author: TFNArmy
quote: GTA 6: 0/10 — One of the Most Overhyped Games in History. GTA 6 is the perfect example of hype completely overshadowing reality. Rockstar has spent years building expectations for a game that, quite frankly, has no chance of living up to them. The trailers look visually impressive, but graphics alone don't make a good game. The gameplay we've seen so far offers little reason to believe this will be some revolutionary experience. The development cycle has been ridiculously long, expectations have become unreasonable, and the gaming community has practically convinced itself that GTA 6 is going to be a masterpiece before even playing it. People are treating Rockstar like they're incapable of making a disappointing game. At the end of the day, GTA 6 is all hype and no substance until proven otherwise. The gaming community needs to stop handing out 10/10 ratings to a game that hasn't even demonstrated that it deserves one. Final rating: 0/10. Overhyped, overanticipated, and massively overrated before release.
